datasets.title: Algeria - Densité des foyers d'incendies dans les wilayas de Bejaia et Tizi Ouzou entre le 09 et le 16 août 2021
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FR20210811DZA Cette carte illustre la densité des foyers d'incendies détectés à partir des données VIIRS acquise entre le 09 et le 16 août 2021. Les wilayas de Bejaia et Tizi Ouzou ont le plus grand nombre de foyers d'incendie avec respectivement 1,502 et 1,733. En se basant sur les données démographique Worldpop, environ 210,000 personnes vivent à proximité des foyers d'incendie. Le pic des foyers d'incendie semble avoir eu lieu entre le 10 et le 13 août 2021. Ceci est une analyse préliminaire et n'a pas encore été validée sur le terrain. Ne pas hésiter à envoyer vos commentaires au Centre Satellitaire des Nations Unies (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/densite-des-foyers-d-incendies-dans-les-wilayas-de-bejaia-et-tizi-ouzou-entre-le-09-et-le-]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts processed VIIRS satellite imagery acquired during August 9-16, 2021 to detect active wildfire hotspots in Bejaia and Tizi Ouzou wilayas. Hotspot density was calculated and mapped by administrative unit. WorldPop demographic data was overlaid to estimate the exposed population living near detected fire locations. This preliminary analysis was conducted without field validation.
